# v2.43-dev Release Notes

## Expiring-soon entries flagged in the program View-students pop-up

A small readability touch on the partner-program **View students** pop-up.

### Changed

- **Soon-to-expire dates are now highlighted.** In the View-students pop-up, any
  person whose training expires within the **next 3 months** now shows their
  **Expires** date in **red**, so at-risk holders stand out at a glance. Entries
  expiring further out are unchanged.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- Purely a display change — counts, membership and the training detail are
  unchanged.
